artworks.title: A Monkey Playing on His Back
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a monkey. The monkey is in a relaxed pose with an expressive face. The image shows a monkey lying down with its limbs extended, one arm raised, and its tail gently curved. The sketch features loose, gestural lines that capture the dynamism of the animal’s form. The face of the monkey is detailed with a subtle expression. Pencil shading is used for light and shadow, adding depth to the drawing. The overall composition maintains a sense of movement and fluidity, suggesting the natural energy of the animal.

artworks.title: Studies of a Left Arm, a Young Woman, a Madonna and Child, a Face in Profile, and Nude Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure with additional sketch elements. The image shows a detailed anatomical study, with a focus on a reclining nude figure on the lower section. Surrounding this main figure are various sketchy elements, including a standing figure on the right and a separate figure in the center with distinct facial features and postures. The composition emphasizes muscle definition and body form, with lines and shading. Text is included in the drawing. The style is fluid and expressive, with loose lines and cross-hatching for shadows and contours.

artworks.title: Studies of a Sculpture of a Male Nude, Vertebrae, and Gesturing Figures
artworks.medium: pen and iron gall ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of fluid lines and shapes arranged in an abstract manner. A central figure resembles a muscular form with exaggerated curves, hinting at a torso and head. Surrounding this figure are additional abstract lines that can be seen as limbs or drapery. The composition includes scribbles and what could be notes or annotations. The image has a textured appearance, with familiar forms emerging from the lines, like a reclining torso or gesturing hands.

artworks.title: Les Mal Tournés
artworks.medium: photo-relief with watercolor stenciling
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a full-profile illustration of a man facing left. He has a pronounced nose, short-cropped hair, and a determined expression. The man wears a dark suit, collar, tie, and dark shoes. His hands are in his pockets, and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features pastel colors and various text elements, including the words "Les Mal Tournés" and details about a performance in Paris with names like Mévisto, René Esse, and Léopold Gangloff.

artworks.title: Salut, Drapeau!
artworks.medium: photo-relief with watercolor stenciling
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cover design for the music sheet of "Salut, Drapeau!" by René Esse. The image features an outdoor scene with exaggerated features and vibrant colors. In the foreground, a male figure with a large bow tie and suit gazes toward another figure who is playing a horn, depicted in a seated position with a plaid shirt. In the background, a soldier stands on a winding path, which separates the color-blocked areas of pink and green, with an abstract representation of a red ship visible on the horizon. Large bold text overlays the image with the title and artist's information.

artworks.title: Théâtre Libre: La Fumée, puis la Flamme
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a theatrical poster for a play titled "La Fumée, puis la Flamme." The artwork features a stylized depiction of smoke transforming into fire, with flowing orange and black forms suggesting movement and transformation. A figure with an elongated arm and flowing hair rises from the flames, intertwining with curvilinear designs. The design includes text in French, listing the cast and details of the theater performance at Le Théâtre Libre for the 1895-1896 season. This is in the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, known for his graphic and innovative poster works for theatrical productions.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Bearded Man in Ancient Dress
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person walking to the right, holding an object in their right hand. They are wearing an ancient Roman or Greek-style draped garment with a head covering. The person's face is in profile, looking slightly upward. Garlands with objects like a basket and cloth hang in the air around them. The background is plain, emphasizing the person and the hanging objects.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.medium: black chalk on bluish laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a young child's head and part of the shoulders, seen from a three-quarter view. The child is positioned slightly angled to the viewer's left. The sketch displays delicate facial features, with softly rounded cheeks, small lips, and a gaze from lightly shaded eyes. The child's hair is depicted in soft, flowing curls that frame the face. The clothing appears to be simple, suggested by faint lines indicating a garment that covers the shoulders. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the subject. The sketch is on textured paper, which shows signs of age, including some stains and creases along the edges.

artworks.title: Dice-Thrower and Other Studies after Ancient Sculptures
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features several figures and heads sketched on a single sheet. There are three detailed head studies and two full figures. The heads display classical Grecian features and varying styles of hair. The largest drawing shows a seated figure draped in flowing garments, with a focus on anatomy, shading, and posture. Light pencil shading emphasizes form and the interplay of light and shade. The composition appears to be a practice piece or preparatory study exploring different angles and expressions in classical art.

artworks.title: Ornament with a Woman in Ancient Dress
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in motion, positioned slightly turned to the viewer's right. They have arms extended to either side, holding a flowing material. Their facial features are delicate with closed eyes or in shadow, and they have long hair. They wear a flowing garment that suggests a long dress or robe. The surroundings include decorative elements like garlands, festooned drapery, and a central feature resembling a classical or mythical mask with horns. The background is simple.

artworks.title: Socrates and Diotime
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in a classical setting. The drawing depicts a seated male figure with a muscular torso, draped in a cloth, sitting on a stool. Adjacent to him is a standing figure, draped in classical attire and extending an arm towards the seated figure with an object resembling a scroll or piece of cloth. The drawing is rendered in fine pencil lines on paper, capturing the contours and shapes with minimal shading.

artworks.title: A River God and Two Classical Sculptures
artworks.medium: gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two classical figures, one standing and one reclining, both appearing to interact with a floating form. The drawing is sketched in neutral tones, primarily in gray, with areas of darker shading emphasizing the forms. The standing figure on the left is draped in flowing garments with a gentle expression, holding an object in one hand and gesturing toward the reclining figure with the other. The reclining figure on the right has a muscular build, leaning back on one arm. A third form is present, which appears to float above the reclining figure, exhibiting dynamic movement in its drapery. The scene suggests a narrative interaction, reminiscent of mythology or classical allegory.

artworks.title: A Muse from the Sarcophagus of the Muses
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman in a three-quarter view, seated and leaning against a column or structure. Her right arm rests on the surface and her head is supported by her hand. She has a pensive expression, with her head slightly tilted. Her hair is styled in a bun and she wears a flowing garment with draped design and loose sleeves. There are no visible objects or jewelry, and the background is minimal and plain.

artworks.title: Warrior with a Shield and Torch
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a warrior in an action pose. A male figure is depicted wearing classical armor, with a short skirt and a round shield strapped to his back. The individual stands in a dynamic stance, holding a torch in one hand, with the flame captured in flowing lines to indicate movement. At his feet lies another figure, whose posture suggests they have fallen. The lines define muscle tone and the folds of the attire. The scene is set against a smoky or cloudy background, with textured lines adding depth behind the main figures. The drawing conveys a sense of drama and historical narrative, characterized by its classical style and energetic composition.

artworks.title: Man Reaching into a Large Basket
artworks.medium: graphite on greenish laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rough sketch featuring lines and shapes that suggest an abstract figure. The drawing features rough pencil strokes outlining an abstract figure in motion. The sketchy lines create an impression of fluid movement, with elongated elements extending from the central form. To the left, there is a block of darker shading that contrasts against the light, loosely drawn subject on the right. The composition captures a moment of activity or action in an unfinished state.

artworks.title: Warrior Seizing a Kneeling Figure
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals. The first figure is shown crouching, facing left with arms extended forward. They have curly hair and wear a long, loose-fitting garment. The second figure is positioned behind the first, leaning forward in a lunging stance with one arm outstretched towards the first person's shoulder. They also have curly hair and wear a short-sleeved garment with a sash at the waist and short, draped attire on the lower body. The background is minimal, with lightly shaded areas. Initials are visible at the bottom left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Classical Sculpture of a Pensive Woman
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a person seated on a structure that resembles a low pedestal or a stone bench. The individual is in a seated pose with their body oriented sideways but with the face slightly turned towards the viewer, one hand resting on the chin. The facial features are not distinctly defined, and the person's hair is long and flowing, partially covered by a bonnet or head covering. The person wears a long, flowing robe or gown that drapes around the body and spills onto the ground. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Mother and Child Flanked by Two Standing Figures
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting three adult figures and one child figure in a classical style. The adult figure on the left is shown in a three-quarter view, slightly turned towards the central figures, with one arm resting on her chin. She is dressed in draped clothing, and her hair is styled in a bun. The central figure is seated with a child on her lap, who appears to be reaching towards her. She is also clad in draped garments with a veil-like covering over her head. The child's body is captured from the back, while reaching up with his left hand. To the right, another adult figure stands, shown in partial profile, leaning slightly forward with one hand to their face and the other resting on a draped surface. The attire of this figure also consists of draped clothing. All figures are placed against a bare background, with no distinct setting or objects present beyond their immediate draped seat.

artworks.title: Seated Woman and Man Sprawling on the Ground
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a sketch. One figure is seated with a slightly tilted head and arms resting on their lap, wearing a long, draped garment. The other figure is shown upside-down and in a dynamic pose, with muscular features and without a shirt.

artworks.title: Niobe and Her Daughter
artworks.medium: black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in dramatic poses. The composition shows one figure standing with an arm raised, gripping a flowing drapery that billows behind them, while the second figure seems to be kneeling or crouching, partially hidden under the first figure. Both figures are adorned in classical, flowing garments. The artwork is rendered with fine lines and subtle shading.

artworks.title: Classical Sculpture of a Woman with an Outstretched Arm
artworks.medium: black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue-like figure draped in flowing robes. The figure stands in a contrapposto pose, with one arm slightly outstretched and the other falling naturally to the side. The clothing is detailed with folds and drapery that emphasize the figure's stance. The shading is subtle yet effective, giving the figure a life-like presence as it stands against a plain background. The drawing is executed with precision, characteristic of historic studies of classical sculpture.

artworks.title: Woman from the Villa Pamphili
artworks.medium: black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The figure's left arm is outstretched to the side while the right arm rests on the hip. The person has a serene facial expression with soft features and styled hair. The attire is a long, flowing draped garment. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the figure. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Woman with a Mirror, from the Villa Borghese
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, partly stained with oil
artworks.description: The image displays a person seen from behind, standing upright with their left arm slightly extended and the right arm resting at their side. The person's hair is neatly styled and gathered at the back, and they are wearing flowing, classical-style drapery that reaches the feet. The left hand appears to be holding or gesturing with an object, and the background is plain with visible stains and discoloration on the paper.

artworks.title: Woman from the Villa Borghese
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, partly stained with oil
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one arm bent and raised, and the other arm extended with an open hand. The person has a calm expression with long, stylized hair. They are wearing a long, flowing robe that covers their body and feet. The attire resembles classical or ancient garments. The background is plain with discoloration and stain marks.
